nodes.label: Envelope (on-disk format)
nodes.rationale: Everything except the KDF parameters (salt, iterations) is encrypted; the box is AES-GCM combined nonce + ciphertext + tag.

nodes.label: VaultFile.update(key:_:)
nodes.rationale: Read-modify-write under an exclusive lock so the app and the CLI never clobber each other.

nodes.label: Biometrics (Touch ID-gated Keychain storage of the vault key)
nodes.norm_label: biometrics (touch id-gated keychain storage of the vault key)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the derived vault key in the data-protection Keychain, readable only after Touch ID. Requires a Team-signed app; otherwise store returns false and Touch ID stays hidden.

nodes.label: DEVELOPMENT_TEAM PX7HA29NR3
nodes.rationale: A Team ID is required to enable Touch ID because the data-protection Keychain needs a signed app.

nodes.label: Provisioning profile requirement
nodes.rationale: The app stores the Touch ID key in the data-protection Keychain, which needs the keychain-access-groups entitlement, and on macOS that entitlement is only valid with a provisioning profile. The release lane fails if the exported app lacks embedded.provisionprofile.

nodes.label: Security scope
nodes.rationale: In scope: vault encryption and format, macOS app, ovault CLI, key handling. Out of scope: attacks that need the Mac already compromised with user privileges while the vault is unlocked.

nodes.label: Auto-lock (inactivity, sleep, screen lock)
nodes.rationale: The vault locks on system sleep, screen lock, or after the configured minutes without keyboard, mouse or scroll activity.

nodes.label: DMG installer window background (soft blue/violet glow with drag-to-Applications arrow)
nodes.norm_label: dmg installer window background (soft blue/violet glow with drag-to-applications arrow)

nodes.label: Biometrics.isEnrolled
nodes.rationale: Checks that a Keychain item exists without prompting (interactionNotAllowed).

nodes.label: LockView (setup and unlock screen)
nodes.rationale: Error shake is the one place overshoot is allowed because it is the feedback; visual and haptic fire on the same frame.

nodes.label: VaultStore.unlock()
nodes.rationale: Returns false on a wrong password so the UI can shake.

nodes.label: VaultStore (observable app state and vault session)
nodes.norm_label: vaultstore (observable app state and vault session)

nodes.label: VaultStore.watchFile()
nodes.rationale: Watches the vault's folder because atomic writes replace the file, so watching the file itself would go stale.

nodes.label: Read-modify-write vault mutations
nodes.rationale: Mutations always re-read, modify and write the vault because the CLI may have written to it meanwhile.

nodes.label: DMG background generator script
nodes.rationale: Light on purpose: Finder paints icon labels dark once a background image is set, so a dark image would hide the names. Single 1x PNG because a @2x pair becomes an uncompressed TIFF of tens of MB. Drawn larger than the window so it still covers a resize.

nodes.label: dmgbuild settings
nodes.rationale: dmgbuild writes .DS_Store itself because the Finder/AppleScript route for the background picture is silently ignored on current macOS. Paths come from -D defines so the lane can pass absolute ones.

nodes.label: Read version from the tag step
nodes.norm_label: read version from the tag step
nodes.rationale: The tag reaches the shell through the environment, never interpolated into the script, because a ref name is attacker-shaped input; tags with unexpected characters are refused. Format <version>[+<build>], build defaults to the workflow run number.

nodes.label: ovaultVersion
nodes.rationale: Placeholder "dev" replaced by the release workflow with the tag version.

nodes.label: fastlane lanes (certificates, test, build, cli, dmg, release)
nodes.norm_label: fastlane lanes (certificates, test, build, cli, dmg, release)

nodes.label: Brand gradient (#4490FE -> #8443D3, 160 deg)
nodes.rationale: Use only on the icon, the lock screen and hero pieces; never behind small text.

nodes.label: Palette
nodes.rationale: Blue and purple share lightness and chroma; neutrals carry about 1% cool (hue 270) to sit with macOS materials. Item-type colors are outside the brand.

nodes.label: App icon: vault door
nodes.rationale: The O is the circular vault door; a gap in the ring and the handle crossing it say the vault is open, but only a little and only for its owner. No padlocks, shields or literal key.

nodes.label: Icon layers are copies, not symlinks
nodes.norm_label: icon layers are copies, not symlinks
nodes.rationale: The Icon Composer exporter used by actool fails with symlinks inside a .icon (status 255), while asset catalogs follow them, so BrandMark is a symlink but the icon layers are copies.

nodes.label: match repo (encrypted certificate and profiles)
nodes.rationale: The Developer ID certificate cannot be created via API (Account Holder only, interactive), so it is imported once from a .p12; one certificate per Team can be shared across apps. In CI match runs read-only, so the profile must exist beforehand.

nodes.norm_label: brand gradient (#4490fe blue to #8443d3 violet, diagonal)
nodes.rationale: Identical linearGradient (x2=0.34, y2=0.94) is used as the icon tile fill in the light icon, the background layer and both lockups; the dark icon inverts it by moving a lightened version (#82B9FF to #B58BF9) onto the mark itself.

nodes.label: OpenVault Vault-Dial Mark (open ring + diagonal handle + center dot)
nodes.norm_label: openvault vault-dial mark (open ring + diagonal handle + center dot)
nodes.rationale: Single geometry reused across every asset: r=300 ring with a dash gap rotated -24deg, a 45deg handle stroke exiting through the gap, and a r=66 center dot, all at stroke-width 72 with round caps. Reads as a vault dial/door left open, matching the 'Open' + 'Vault' name. Only color and container change between variants.

nodes.label: Brand gradient (blue to purple diagonal)
nodes.rationale: Single blue-to-purple gradient is the identity colour: icon background in default appearance, mark fill in dark appearance, and a faint glow in the social preview and DMG background.

nodes.label: macOS app icon appearance variants (default / dark / tinted)
nodes.norm_label: macos app icon appearance variants (default / dark / tinted)
nodes.rationale: Three renderings of the same icon so the system can pick one per appearance mode; tinted is monochrome so the OS can apply its own tint.

nodes.norm_label: openvault wordmark (two-tone: 'open' in blue, 'vault' in ink/white)

nodes.label: Product positioning: native macOS secrets manager, encrypted and local, no cloud (.env, API keys, SSH, GPG in one vault; app + CLI)
nodes.norm_label: product positioning: native macos secrets manager, encrypted and local, no cloud (.env, api keys, ssh, gpg in one vault; app + cli)

nodes.label: OpenVault vault-dial mark (open ring with gap, diagonal handle stroke, center dot)
nodes.norm_label: openvault vault-dial mark (open ring with gap, diagonal handle stroke, center dot)
nodes.rationale: Glyph reads as a safe/vault dial whose ring is broken open by a handle stroke, visualising an 'open' vault; rounded stroke caps keep it legible down to 16px.

nodes.label: ovault CLI example: `ovault run -- npm run dev`
nodes.norm_label: ovault cli example: `ovault run -- npm run dev`

nodes.label: App Icon (Liquid Glass handle + ring on brand gradient)
nodes.norm_label: app icon (liquid glass handle + ring on brand gradient)

nodes.label: /graphify . --update (incremental re-extraction)
nodes.rationale: Only re-extracts what changed; code-only changes use no LLM. graphify-out/ is committed together with the change.

nodes.label: Knowledge graph (graphify) in graphify-out/
nodes.rationale: Used to orient in the code and so AI agents query the graph instead of re-reading the whole repo.

nodes.label: graphify workflow for agents (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Agents should consult the knowledge graph before walking files by hand, and answer only with what the graph contains.

nodes.label: Group assets/brand images by format
nodes.rationale: Brand images are variants of the same icon, so group them by format instead of launching one agent per image.

nodes.label: EXTRACTED / INFERRED / AMBIGUOUS relation labels
nodes.rationale: INFERRED and AMBIGUOUS relations are hypotheses: verify them in code before asserting them.

nodes.label: Versioned vs local graphify artifacts
nodes.rationale: GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.html and graph.json are versioned; cache, manifest.json, cost.json and .graphify_* files contain absolute paths so they stay local and gitignored.

nodes.norm_label: contributing flow (branch from dev, conventional commits, pr to dev)

nodes.norm_label: drag and drop with type detection

nodes.label: GPG keys (fingerprint and identity without keyring import)
nodes.norm_label: gpg keys (fingerprint and identity without keyring import)

nodes.label: Item types (.env, secret, password, SSH, GPG, file, other)
nodes.norm_label: item types (.env, secret, password, ssh, gpg, file, other)

nodes.label: Makefile targets (open, install-cli, test, cli, project, app, clean, dmg)
nodes.norm_label: makefile targets (open, install-cli, test, cli, project, app, clean, dmg)

nodes.label: Master password
nodes.rationale: Cannot be recovered if forgotten. Changing it re-encrypts the whole vault with a new salt.

nodes.label: OPENVAULT_PASSWORD environment variable
nodes.rationale: Master password without prompt (useful in CI); removed from the environment before ovault run.

nodes.label: ovault CLI
nodes.rationale: Injects project secrets as environment variables without the .env ever existing on disk.

nodes.label: ovault init / import / set / get / export / list
nodes.norm_label: ovault init / import / set / get / export / list
nodes.rationale: set reads the value from stdin when omitted so it does not end up in shell history.

nodes.label: ovault hook (automatic shell loading on cd)
nodes.norm_label: ovault hook (automatic shell loading on cd)
nodes.rationale: Never prompts for the master password: loads only if OPENVAULT_PASSWORD is set. Warns on every load because a foreign repo with a .ovault naming one of your projects would receive that environment.

nodes.label: ovault load
nodes.rationale: Also exposes passwords (NAME and NAME_USERNAME) and files, written to a private temp directory (0700, file 0600) with their path exported; SSH/GPG keys and 'other' items are not loaded.

nodes.label: .ovault project file (project-name=...)
nodes.rationale: Plain text that only names the project and never contains secrets; searched upward from the current directory and wins over .openvault in the same directory.

nodes.label: Shared vault file (vault.ovault)
nodes.rationale: App and CLI read the same file directly, so the CLI works with the app closed and the app instantly reflects CLI writes. Stored at ~/Library/Application Support/OpenVault/vault.ovault with 0600 permissions (folder 0700).

nodes.label: SSH keys (ed25519 generation, fingerprint, export to ~/.ssh)
nodes.norm_label: ssh keys (ed25519 generation, fingerprint, export to ~/.ssh)

nodes.label: Touch ID unlock (Keychain-protected key)
nodes.rationale: Requires a signed app; without signing the Touch ID button does not appear.

nodes.label: OpenVault (developer secrets manager for macOS)
nodes.rationale: Dev secrets end up scattered across unencrypted .env files, notes and ~/.ssh folders; OpenVault keeps them in a single encrypted vault with the passphrases needed to use each key.

nodes.label: Exclusive-lock writes with re-read before modify
nodes.norm_label: exclusive-lock writes with re-read before modify
nodes.rationale: App and CLI write under an exclusive lock and re-read the latest version before modifying, so they do not overwrite each other.

nodes.label: Vault encryption (AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-SHA256, 600k iterations)
nodes.rationale: Nothing is stored in plaintext; key derived from the master password.
